tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Euler--Lagrange equation for harmonic maps] 1. ch8:8.4-thm-5\group Constrained Minimization Let $\mathbf{u} \in \mathcal{A}$ satisfy \[ I[\mathbf{u}] = \min _{\mathbf{w} \in \mathcal{A}} I[\mathbf{w}]. \] Then \[ \int _U D\mathbf{u} : D\mathbf{v}\, dx = \int _U |D\mathbf{u}|^2 \mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v}\, dx \tag {33} \] for each $\mathbf{v} \in H_0^1(U;\R ^m) \cap L^\infty (U;\R ^m)$.

Proof

\sketch Use the admissible normalized variations $(\mathbf u+\tau \mathbf v)/|\mathbf u+\tau \mathbf v|$. Their derivative at zero is $\mathbf v-(\mathbf u\cdot \mathbf v)\mathbf u$; substituting it into the first variation and using $D\mathbf u^T\mathbf u=0$ gives (33).

□
